title: fs-dir: inotify thread in wp11_pkcs11.c
description: Add a dedicated inotify background thread for the fs-dir directory (separate from the existing USB flash inotify thread). Watch for IN_CREATE, IN_DELETE, IN_MOVED_TO, IN_MOVED_FROM on files matching slot-N.p11k. Call slot_add_fs_dir / slot_remove_fs_dir and fire C_WaitForSlotEvent via hotplug_push_event. Include wake pipe and g_fs_dir_thread_running atomic flag (same pattern as g_flash_thread_running).
